V.1.3.description:
# LET IT DIE Archipelago - Version 1.3

## Progressive Floor

**progressive_floor** is optional and defaults to false. When enabled, Progressive Floor permanently unlocks numbered ascents within each ten-floor band. The transitions 10->11, 20->21, 30->31 and 40->41 are exempt. **progressive_floor_quantity** defaults to 36. Minimum quantities by goal are 9 for Max Sharps,18 for Jackson, 27 for Crowley and 36 for Taro Gunkanyama. Insufficient enabled quantities are rejected during generation. Floor items apply through the existing Waiting Room delivery point; extra copies beyond the goal requirement have no further effect. Universal Tracker uses the same floor requirements.

## MasterySanity

- **mastery_sanity**: optional mastery checks, false by default.
- **mastery_checks**:1..20 checks per eligible mastery, default 20. Levels are evenly spaced and always include 20. Seven checks use 3,6,9,11,14,17,20.
- **mastery_include_fists**: include fist checks, true by default. Fists also cap at 20.
- **mastery_xp_multiplier**:1..100, default 1. Multiplies native mastery XP from enemy defeats; normal fighter XP is unchanged. This option also works with MasterySanity disabled, I recommend multiplying the XP by 10 if you activate mastery sanity

Only weapon families available through the run's allowed AP progressives receive mastery locations. The tracker also considers received weapons, their current upgrade requirements and the six AP base stats. Optional temporary bonuses or requirement-reducing decals are not assumed as guaranteed access. Native level rewards and XP display remain in control of the game.

## Shop Sanity

With ShopSanity enabled, opening a buy list reveals Archipelago hints for that merchant's currently available, unpurchased offers. Momoka hints only her currently unlocked Kill Coin offers, including all available categories; later unlocks are not revealed in advance. Insufficient KC does not hide an otherwise unlocked offer. Tower hints belong to the exact merchant opened.

Each shop location is hinted once per run. This addition needs no new generation for an existing ShopSanity-enabled run. Opening a shop does not buy an item or grant a reward.

## Bug fix

There was an issue in previous versions where your character's stats were the same as the rank 1 screamers, so the higher your stats were, the higher the enemies' stats were too. The problem has been fixed.

V1.1.description:
## LET IT DIE Archipelago - V1.1

## Changes in V1.1

- Pop-up messages are added to indicate the sending of checks as well as the receipt of items.

## Checks/Locations
- **ChestSanity** added as a check for red, silver, and gold chests, the values in the YAML correspond to the number of chests requested for each set of 10 floors.
- **MaterialSanity** added as checks the 6 plan upgrade materials as well as faction metals, the values in the YAML indicate the number of materials that must be collected for each type of material and metal.

## Filler 
- **KC** added Kill Coins as filler 2,000, 10,000, and 50,000 KC, each with a percentage adjustable in the YAML

### Link to the apworld and YAML source code https://github.com/Neo-Prod/Let-it-Die-Archipelago/tree/releaseV1.1
V1.1.title: Let it Die archipelago V1.1

V1.2.description:
## ShopSanity

The supplied YAML enables **shop_sanity**. 
Momoka's Kill Coin decal stock and the Wednesday tower merchants become AP purchase locations. 
Each tower merchant has three fixed blueprint slots. 
Purchases send checks and become unavailable after completion. 

## Equipment progression

Equipment catalogue tiers now range from 1 to 9. **maximum_equipment_tier** defaults to 6. 
**equipment_upgrade_steps** defaults to 0 and accepts 0 to 4 extra receipts between tier-table milestones. 
For example, 2 gives +0, +2, +4, then the next equipment rank. 
Uncapped milestones follow the tier table, including +5/+10/+15/+20 where applicable.
